summary: Tested the new 'Diskon & Hadiah' feature (promo code + Tukar 100 Poin, both admin-PIN gated) against the real Supabase DB. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass. Covered promo valid/min-order/unknown/wrong PIN (one attempt)/no auth, points ok/insufficient/unknown, transaction without PIN -> 403, and a transaction with promo+points (totals, fields, loyalty trigger). Frontend: redeem disabled without customer; promo -> PIN dialog -> line + reduced total; remove restores; insufficient points shows PIN-dialog error; promo+points applied, remove/re-add points; one real payment; receipt shows receipt-promo/receipt-points; /pos 800x1280 has no horizontal overflow. No functional bugs found.

minor.issue: Race: points are pre-checked in Python, then the DB trigger subtracts pointsRedeemed. If points drop between the check and the insert, the trigger raises 'Poin pelanggan tidak cukup' as a generic DB exception. That likely surfaces as 500, not 400. Map it to 400 (or deduct atomically with 'update ... where points >= required').
When customerId is set, body.customerName is ignored (UI-entered 'TEST_UIDisc' saved as 'TEST_Poin'). This is existing behaviour; confirm it is intended.
PRD-002 in the real DB is 'Kopi Susu Besar' Rp13.000, not Cafe Latte 28000. 2x = 26000 is correctly rejected by the TEST10 min order (400). Tests used 4x PRD-002 (52000) instead.

issues: The customer's current points are not shown. 'Tukar 100 Poin' stays enabled for a customer with fewer than 100 points; the user only learns it is insufficient after entering the admin PIN. Show the points balance and disable the button when points < required_points.
The admin PIN is asked again for each discount (promo, then points). This is acceptable but could reuse the PIN already authorised in the dialog.

action_items: Optional: show customer points in PayDialog and disable 'Tukar 100 Poin' when points < required.
Optional: map the loyalty-trigger points exception to a 400, or deduct points atomically.

Clean up the T1 records listed in seed_data_creation. NOTE: real stock INV-002 'Susu Kental Manis' is now only 1 (204 used by the T1 API test transaction). Restore it if the customer wants it (it was 205).
critical_code_review_comments: discounts.promo_discount loads all active promos and matches the code in Python. Fine for small tables; a case-insensitive query would scale better.
Promo has no usage limit or per-customer limit. The spec doesn't require one.
create_transaction is still non-atomic (from iteration_1): transaction insert, bill delete and table updates are separate statements.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (waiter Targets page not tested: no known waiter PIN)
